tenant_id.hint: Your Microsoft 365 tenant ID (also called Directory ID). Find it in Entra admin centre → Overview, or Azure Portal → Azure Active Directory → Properties. Looks like: xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx

client_id.hint: The Application (client) ID of your Azure App Registration. Create one at portal.azure.com → Entra ID → App registrations → New registration. Grant it the API permissions listed in the README, then create a client secret.

cert_thumbprint.hint: The SHA-1 thumbprint of the certificate uploaded to your App Registration under Certificates & secrets → Certificates. Strip the colons — 40 hex characters, e.g. E451C51BEAD2B2053D5D7CCC606FDA1CB1C2180C. Get it with: openssl x509 -in cert.pem -noout -fingerprint -sha1

cert_private_key.hint: Paste the full contents of your private key PEM file here, including the -----BEGIN ... ----- and -----END ... ----- lines. This is the private key that matches the certificate uploaded to Azure. Keep this secret — it authenticates the plugin in place of a client secret.

user_email.hint: The email address of the user whose mailbox and Teams activity this plugin will act on — e.g. user@yourcompany.com. The app must have been granted permissions (with admin consent) to act on that user's behalf.

enable_teams_read.hint: When ON, /m365-teams-read and the read_teams_messages LLM tool are active. Requires ChannelMessage.Read.All and Team.ReadBasic.All app permissions with admin consent.

enable_email_read.hint: When ON, /m365-email-read and the read_emails LLM tool fetch emails from the inbox of user_email. Requires Mail.Read (or Mail.ReadWrite) app permission with admin consent.

enable_email_draft.hint: When ON, /m365-email-draft saves a message to the user's Drafts folder without sending it. Requires Mail.ReadWrite app permission with admin consent.

enable_email_send.hint: When ON, /m365-email-send and /m365-email-reply actually transmit email. Disabled by default — turn on only after verifying config. Requires Mail.Send app permission with admin consent.

enable_background_poll.description: Enable: background polling for new messages/emails
enable_background_poll.hint: When ON, the plugin periodically checks for new emails and Teams messages and notifies the active AstrBot session. Uses poll_interval_seconds. Turn OFF to reduce API calls and avoid noise.

poll_interval_seconds.hint: How often to check for new emails and Teams messages when background polling is enabled. Microsoft Graph API rate limits apply — 60 seconds minimum recommended.

email_max_results.description: Max emails to return per read
email_max_results.hint: Limits how many emails are shown by /m365-email-read and the read_emails LLM tool. Keep low (5–20) to avoid flooding the chat.

teams_max_results.description: Max Teams messages to return per read
teams_max_results.hint: Limits messages shown by /m365-teams-read and the read_teams_messages LLM tool.

watch_team_name.description: Default Teams team name to monitor
watch_team_name.hint: The display name of the Microsoft Team to use when no team is specified in a command — e.g. 'Contoso IT'. Leave blank to require an explicit team name each time.

watch_channel_name.description: Default Teams channel name to monitor
watch_channel_name.hint: The channel to use when no channel is specified — e.g. 'General'. Leave blank to require an explicit channel name each time.

email_inbox_folder.hint: The mailbox folder for /m365-email-read. Use 'inbox' for the inbox, or any well-known folder name (drafts, sentitems, deleteditems) or a custom folder display name.
